title: alnus glutinosa var. emarginata
intro: Alnus glutinosa var. emarginata, commonly known as Emarginate Alder, is a plant species within the Alnus genus that is native to certain regions. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential use in treating infections and inflammation due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. Emarginate Alder is believed to possess therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerogenic effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of certain diseases. The bioactive constituents of Emarginate Alder include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
